verdicts.reason: A: 'MERRY' is crowded by the heart-monster, bell, candy cane and gifts, which collide with it on the left; 'DISCOUNT' runs right into the small monsters; the characters are squeezed into a cluttered strip with uneven gaps, such as the empty space before the star monster, and the text is tiny. B has the same 'MERRY' collisions with the bell, candy cane and gifts, plus a dead gap after the yeti on the left and a jammed right cluster where the red monster, holly, ghost and star monster pile into each other, so it looks slightly more chaotic.
